info.title: BORVAT MVP proposed API
info.description: NOT IMPLEMENTED. Test-only contracts; no live base URL. Server infers principal and company permissions. Auth registration/reset/OAuth delegated to existing identity provider; exact redirect/session/verification contract to pin in C0. Schema names map to existing DB only after ADR.

post.description: Company membership and application-write capability; draft only.
Independent platform reviewer, no membership of applicant; does not activate PSP.

get.description: Only active approved offers, deterministic sort total-price/delivery with ranking disclosure.

patch.description: Check seller scope and price permission; creates immutable version; not a stock update.

post.description: Validate seller approval, PSP sandbox capability, tax/shipping/product safety before active test listing.
Single seller only; server totals; 422 mixed_seller_checkout/stale_price/missing_tax/stock_unavailable; 409 stale cart version.
Reserve stock and persist pending order/attempt. PSP TEST only. Returns 202 while session creation is pending; no paid claim.
Guard capture/cancel race; after capture transitions refund workflow, not false unconditional cancellation.

get.description: Serialize ONLY this seller slice; never entire multi-seller root or other sellers/PII.

post.description: Buyer owns order+lines; record statutory notice immediately and captured confirmation message. No real outbound email during tests.
Authorized finance command; amount computed from approved line allocation server-side. Test mode only, lock refundable balance.
Owned delivered line; verified_purchase computed, never client-supplied.
Accessible notice route, abuse throttled; do not require account to report unsafe/illegal offer.
Authenticate or verified alternative identity recovery; statutory retention exceptions explicit.
Scoped delegated capability. Proposal only in this mission. No autonomous financial execution; approval bound to exact body/hash and expected version.
Raw-body signature and timestamp validation, account+test-mode match, durable inbox before ACK. Reconcile authoritative PSP status. No browser bearer auth.
PSP TEST hosted flow only. Authorize entity owner; never collect bank credentials in platform. Callback is not capability proof; reconcile PSP account webhook.
Draft only; independent finance approver activates effective rule, never retroactive order mutation.

get.description: Scoped UTC period, returns gross/refund/commission separately; PII minimized.

post.description: Participant/assigned-support authorization; attached documents checked for same scope and clean scan.

get.description: Explicit audit-read permission, bounded time/tenant filter; no secrets or KYB document content.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Same principal+operation+key+request hash returns same resource/response; mismatched hash 409. External provider keys correlated; financial dedup retained.

ProviderEvent.description: Raw signed provider envelope; verify signature over exact bytes BEFORE validation/processing. Never trust company ID from payload metadata.

x-global-rules: Server validates JSON before effects; no mass assignment; precise enum/state validation
Write authorization derives from session+capability+ownership, not caller company_id alone
Optimistic version for updates; 409 stale version. Idempotency protects concurrent retries
All list endpoints bounded cursor pagination; parent ownership checked before filtering children
Error code examples: mixed_seller_checkout, quote_expired, stale_version, stock_unavailable, missing_tax, seller_not_approved, provider_ineligible, idempotency_conflict
Public product response requires approved publication/safety; no private tax/KYB data
Future stock-adjustment path belongs to Warehouse, never offer price endpoint; provider payouts observed only
Webhook 2xx only after durable enqueue; signature failure 400; retryable storage failure 503. No Idempotency-Key required from provider
